season_definition: An annual Magic Pass season runs from May through April, except the founding 2017/2018 pass which began on 1 November 2017.
interpretation: Only explicit positive roster or continuation evidence is encoded. Absence from a non-exhaustive press release is never treated as non-membership.

observations.note: Visual review of operator tariff dated 2021-11-04: Magic Pass valid on all lifts for winter 2021/2022 (2021-12-18 to 2022-03-13), with train access limited to skiers/snowboarders. Seasonal membership evidence, not a claim of continuous operation.

Visual review of Fribourg Region winter release dated 2021-12-01: final paragraph names Moleson-sur-Gruyeres among seven ski stations and explicitly states that all participate in the annual Magic Pass. Applies to forthcoming winter 2021/2022.

Visual review of page 2: boxed roster explicitly applies to 2019/2020 and names both Anniviers components, all three Espace Dent Blanche components, Riviera (including Les Pleiades), and Villars-Gryon-Les Diablerets. This is a dated PDF roster, not the live website navigation.

Operator tariff dated 2020-11-01 explicitly accepts Magic Pass on all lifts for winter 2020/2021 (2020-12-12 to 2021-03-14), with restricted ski/snowboard access to the train. Evidence establishes winter membership, not continuous operation or unrestricted year-round rail validity.

Magic Pass branded map hosted by Raiffeisen, with printed validity 2024-05-01 to 2025-04-30. Visual review verifies winter/summer-winter symbols beside each named component (including Faltschen and Kiental); baths are distinct. Map absence is not coded as non-membership.
The official press release presents the annual 2018/2019 pass and lists its participating domains.
The release states that Saas-Fee remains in Magic Pass and expands its summer participation; it is not a full roster.
The official follow-up describes the Haut-Valais axis as developed with Saas-Fee; it is not a full roster.
The official 2022/2023 dossier page 6 lists partner and new base stations.
The official dossier separates partner and new stations and provides the complete base roster.
The official dossier provides a numbered list of 99 base destinations, including grouped domain headings.
